stories.title: Trump retira sus amenazas y afirma que no prohibirá las exportaciones de diésel

en.title: Trump withdraws threats and states he will not ban diesel exports
en.summary: The US president had previously suggested requesting European countries to release diesel reserves and considered banning diesel exports, but later softened his position by acknowledging potential negative effects on gasoline prices.

stories.title: Marcha del 2 de octubre en CDMX: Horarios, ruta y calles que tendrán afectaciones

en.title: October 2 march in Mexico City: schedules, route and affected streets
en.summary: Marches scheduled for October 2 in Mexico City will depart from Tlatelolco and Hemiciclo a Juárez, with specific schedules, routes and road closures announced.

stories.title: Trump celebra que Europa liberó 100 millones de barriles de petróleo y derivados; descarta prohibir exportaciones de diésel

en.title: Trump celebrates Europe releasing 100 million barrels of oil and derivatives; rules out banning diesel exports
en.summary: The US president stated that European countries use fuel disproportionately and welcomed their release of 100 million barrels of oil and derivatives as a positive action.

stories.title: Actuación de policías en marcha de este 2 de octubre será vigilada por Supervisores de DH: SSC CDMX; solo portarán equipo de protección personal

en.title: Police conduct during October 2 march will be monitored by Human Rights Supervisors: SSC CDMX; officers will only carry personal protective equipment
en.summary: Human rights supervisors will oversee police actions at the October 2 march, coordinating with human rights organizations and political conciliation areas, with officers equipped only with protective gear.

stories.title: EU intercepta buque con combustible para Cuba; empleaba tácticas de la "flota fantasma", acusa

en.title: EU intercepts ship with fuel for Cuba; employed 'ghost fleet' tactics, accuses
en.summary: European Union authorities intercepted a vessel carrying fuel destined for Cuba that was allegedly using deceptive shipping practices associated with ghost fleet operations.

stories.title: Dedican billete de Lotería al Bicentenario del Consulado de México en Nueva York, una de las representaciones más antiguas en el mundo

en.title: Lottery ticket dedicated to bicentennial of Mexican consulate in New York, one of the oldest representations in the world
en.summary: Mexico's North America undersecretary highlighted how the bicentennial commemoration emphasizes the shared history between Mexico and the United States and the consulate's role in Mexican foreign policy.

stories.title: Lotería Nacional devela billete del Consulado de México en Nueva York; celebra 200 años de creación

en.title: National Lottery unveils ticket for Mexican Consulate in New York; celebrates 200 years of creation
en.summary: The National Lottery released a special ticket commemorating the Mexican Consulate in New York's bicentennial, with the grand prize totaling 21 million pesos.

stories.title: Michoacán prepara más de 700 eventos para celebrar la Noche de Muertos 2026

en.title: Michoacán prepares over 700 events to celebrate Day of the Dead 2026
en.summary: The state of Michoacán is organizing more than 700 events to commemorate the Day of the Dead festivities in 2026.

stories.title: Michoacán anuncia más de 700 actividades culturales y rituales para Noche de Muertos 2026

en.title: Michoacán announces over 700 cultural activities and rituals for Day of the Dead 2026
en.summary: Michoacán will host more than 700 cultural, artistic, and ceremonial events across its seven tourist regions from October 23 to November 2, 2026, marking a historic celebration of Day of the Dead.

stories.title: México necesita un mayor ajuste fiscal para contener la deuda, advierte FMI; prevé un PIB de 1.5%

en.title: Mexico needs greater fiscal adjustment to contain debt, IMF warns; forecasts 1.5% GDP
en.summary: The IMF raised its 2024 growth forecast for Mexico to 1.5% from 1.2% and lowered its 2027 GDP projection to 1.8% from 1.9%, while cautioning that stronger fiscal measures are necessary.

stories.title: EU intercepta buque con "combustible ilegal" rumbo a Cuba; México participó en la inspección

en.title: US intercepts vessel with "illegal fuel" bound for Cuba; Mexico participated in inspection
en.summary: The United States Coast Guard seized the cargo ship Grace, which was transporting fuel illegally to Cuba, with Mexico's participation in the inspection operation.

stories.title: Matan dos ex alumnos a maestra en secundaria

en.title: Two former students kill teacher at secondary school
en.summary: Two brothers who were former students entered Secondary School 13 in Torreón, attacked teachers and students, and killed the vice principal.

stories.title: Reforma Judicial frena inversiones de 28.8% de empresas, según Coparmex

en.title: Judicial Reform slows investments for 28.8% of companies, according to Coparmex
en.summary: Uncertainty about contracts, property rights, and legal remedies has prompted a large majority of surveyed businesses to strengthen legal protections or consider operational changes in response to judicial reform.

stories.title: Pemex pierde ingresos millonarios con el petróleo caro y sus exportaciones en mínimos

en.title: Pemex loses substantial income with expensive oil and exports at record lows
en.summary: Pemex oil production reached historic lows in August, reducing export capacity despite crude prices exceeding 100 dollars per barrel.

stories.title: Antes de que naciera Carlos Slim, Telcel ya tenía historia: comenzó con directorios y hoy genera 275,000 mdp

en.title: Before Carlos Slim was born, Telcel already had history: it started with directories and today generates 275,000 million pesos
en.summary: Telcel, which originated as a telephone directory business, became central to Carlos Slim's telecommunications empire and now represents a key revenue source for América Móvil.

stories.title: La Ley de Economía Digital es aprobada por diputados en Comisión de Hacienda

en.title: Digital Economy Law approved by deputies in Finance Commission
en.summary: Mexico's Finance Commission approved a digital economy proposal from President Claudia Sheinbaum aimed at reducing cash usage, with 25 votes in favor, four against, and zero abstentions.

stories.title: Robo de identidad y el fraude son las mayores amenazas para los mexicanos: Buró de Crédito

en.title: Identity theft and fraud are the greatest threats for Mexicans: Credit Bureau
en.summary: A TransUnion study indicates that 21 percent of Mexico's population does not take cybersecurity measures despite increased risk of digital fraud.
